raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "cantilever proportions and cell aspect ratio",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 5.2 specifies a 40-by-120 mesh, but gives no physical dimensions, square-cell assumption, or assignment of mesh directions to beam length and height.",
      "readings": [
        "120 cells along the beam and 40 across it, with square cells: L/H=3.",
        "120 cells along the beam and 40 across it, with cell width/height=1/3: L/H=1.",
        "40 cells along the beam and 120 across it, with square cells: L/H=1/3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "absolute geometric scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither Sec. 5.2 nor the Fig. 1 caption gives lengths or physical units. Overall scale remains unspecified even after choosing proportions.",
      "readings": [
        "For a 3:1 beam, use L=120 and H=40 in consistent units.",
        "For the same proportions, use L=3 and H=1, scaling spatial filter and averaging radii proportionally."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "placement of the fixed cantilever root in the grid",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The Fig. 1 caption identifies a cantilever, but the supplied text does not locate its fixed root on a particular grid side; Sec. 5.2 refers to the unavailable Fig. 1a.",
      "readings": [
        "Clamp the entire left edge; the loaded tip is on the right.",
        "Clamp the entire right edge; the loaded tip is on the left.",
        "Orient the beam vertically and clamp its entire bottom edge."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "finite-element formulation",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 5.2 gives mesh dimensions, but neither it nor Sec. 3.2 specifies element interpolation or integration.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with 2-by-2 Gauss integration.",
        "Eight-node serendipity quadrilaterals with 3-by-3 Gauss integration."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "conversion from load angle to force components",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 5.2 and the Fig. 1 caption specify angles in [0, pi], but do not define the zero direction or positive angular sense. Sec. 5.3 supplies no component formula.",
      "readings": [
        "Measure counterclockwise from +x: Fx=F cos(theta), Fy=F sin(theta).",
        "Measure clockwise from +x: Fx=F cos(theta), Fy=-F sin(theta).",
        "Measure clockwise from +y: Fx=F sin(theta), Fy=F cos(theta)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "individual load angle represented by Fig. 1a",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "The Fig. 1 caption gives only a distribution. Sec. 5.4 attributes four specific angles to Fig. 1, although Fig. 4's caption describes the corresponding comparison of generated and ground-truth layouts.",
      "readings": [
        "Take Sec. 5.4 literally and run separate problems at 0.3pi, 0.4pi, 0.45pi, and 0.55pi for Fig. 1.",
        "Treat those four angles as Fig. 4 settings; Fig. 1a is another unspecified draw, for example theta=0.5pi."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "single nodal point force",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 5.2–5.3 specify the point load's angle and component representation, but never give its magnitude or force units.",
      "readings": [
        "Use a constant force magnitude F=1 in consistent solver units.",
        "Use a constant force magnitude F=1000 in the same units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "prescribed solid or void cells",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 5.2 and the Fig. 1 caption give no passive-region mask or explicit confirmation that attachment and loading cells are freely designable.",
      "readings": [
        "Optimize every cell; prescribe no passive regions.",
        "Keep the entire root-adjacent cell column solid.",
        "Keep the root-adjacent column and the two tip-adjacent cells incident on the middle loading node solid."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "shared global and local density threshold alpha",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 defines both density constraints using alpha, and Algorithm 2 requires alpha as input, but no Case 1 value is supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "Set alpha=0.3 for both constraints.",
        "Set alpha=0.4 for both constraints.",
        "Set alpha=0.5 for both constraints."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "solid material stiffness scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 introduces K without supplying Young's modulus or another numerical scale for the solid constitutive tensor.",
      "readings": [
        "Normalize the solid Young's modulus to E=1.",
        "Use E=210000 N/mm^2 with consistent force and length units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "constitutive tensor beyond its overall stiffness scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The text supplies neither Poisson's ratio nor an explicit isotropy assumption or material-axis orientation.",
      "readings": [
        "Use an isotropic material with Poisson's ratio 0.",
        "Use an isotropic material with Poisson's ratio 0.3.",
        "Use an orthotropic material with E_parallel/E_transverse=2, nu_parallel_transverse=0.25, and G=0.4 E_transverse, aligned with the beam."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "two-dimensional elastic idealization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 5.2 calls Case 1 a 2D structure, but does not specify plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Use plane stress.",
        "Use plane strain."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No thickness or per-unit-thickness convention is stated for assembling the 2D stiffness matrix and interpreting the point force.",
      "readings": [
        "Use unit thickness t=1.",
        "Use uniform thickness t=0.1 in the selected length units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "mapping from physical density rho to element stiffness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 specifies x-to-rho filtering and projection, but never defines rho-to-K interpolation. Its p=16 is the local-density norm exponent, not a stated stiffness penalization exponent.",
      "readings": [
        "Use linear stiffness interpolation proportional to rho.",
        "Use SIMP interpolation proportional to rho^3.",
        "Use SIMP interpolation proportional to rho^4."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "residual stiffness assigned to void",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Although zero density is permitted, Sec. 3.2 gives no minimum stiffness or singular-stiffness regularization.",
      "readings": [
        "Use E_min=0.",
        "Use E_min=10^-9 E_solid.",
        "Use E_min=10^-3 E_solid."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density-filter radius r_e",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eqs. (3)–(4) and Algorithm 2 require r_e, but no Case 1 value or unit convention is supplied. Let h denote the smallest selected cell dimension.",
      "readings": [
        "Use r_e=1.5h everywhere.",
        "Use r_e=3h everywhere.",
        "Use r_e=0.05L everywhere."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "filter-neighborhood membership M_e",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 calls M_e the set of neighboring elements without explicitly defining membership or self-inclusion; the weight formula alone does not select that set.",
      "readings": [
        "Include the element itself and every element centroid within r_e.",
        "Include every other element centroid within r_e, excluding the element itself.",
        "Include the element itself and only its edge-sharing neighbors, using Eq. (4) weights."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "projection continuation endpoints",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Algorithm 2 doubles beta, but neither the initial beta nor the stopping input beta_t is supplied for Case 1.",
      "readings": [
        "Start beta=1 and set beta_t=8.",
        "Start beta=1 and set beta_t=32.",
        "Start beta=2 and set beta_t=32."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "local-density averaging radius R_e",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 5.2 invokes (TO), which includes the local constraint, but no numerical R_e is given. Under the spatial-neighborhood interpretation, let h be the smallest cell dimension.",
      "readings": [
        "Use R_e=2h everywhere.",
        "Use R_e=6h everywhere.",
        "Use R_e at least as large as the domain diagonal, so every neighborhood contains all elements."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "meaning of the local-density neighborhood N_e",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 defines x_i as scalar design variables and z_i as element coordinates, but defines the supposedly spatial local neighborhood using distances between x_i and x_e.",
      "readings": [
        "Treat x in the neighborhood definition as a notation error and use centroid distances ||z_i-z_e||<=R_e.",
        "Read the equation literally and select elements by scalar design-value proximity |x_i-x_e|<=R_e, updating membership as x changes."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "permitted global and local constraint violations",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Algorithm 2 continues while either g_i>0, implying zero positive feasibility tolerance. Sec. 5.4 instead attributes positive ground-truth violations to nonzero error thresholds without specifying those thresholds.",
      "readings": [
        "Require g_0<=0 and g_1<=0 literally.",
        "Allow g_0<=10^-3 and g_1<=10^-3.",
        "Allow g_0<=0.05 and g_1<=10^-3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "final optimality stopping test",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Algorithm 2 declares epsilon_opt=10^-3 but never uses it. Its inner loop instead uses epsilon=1, with no tightening rule, leaving the intended role of the optimality tolerance unclear.",
      "readings": [
        "Leave epsilon_opt unused and apply the listed direction-magnitude threshold epsilon=1.",
        "Use epsilon_opt=10^-3 as the final direction-magnitude threshold.",
        "Tighten epsilon from 1 toward 10^-3 between augmented-Lagrangian updates."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "enforcement of design-variable box bounds",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "(TO) requires x_e in [0,1], but Algorithm 2 clips only the increment to [-0.1,0.1]; its trial update contains no box projection or feasibility restriction.",
      "readings": [
        "Project every trial design component onto [0,1].",
        "Restrict the line-search step length so every trial component remains in [0,1]."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "augmented-Lagrangian quadratic penalty coefficient",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Algorithm 2's merit function contains 0.5 g_i^2/r_i, whose derivative contributes g_i/r_i, while its search direction and multiplier update use 2g_i/r_i.",
      "readings": [
        "Keep the stated merit function and use the matching coefficient mu_i+g_i/r_i in its gradient.",
        "Keep the stated search-direction coefficient and change the quadratic merit penalty to g_i^2/r_i."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "inequality activation and multiplier feasibility",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Algorithm 2 activates constraint-gradient terms only for g_i>0, but evaluates unconditional quadratic merit penalties. Its multiplier update can also produce negative multipliers, contrary to Eq. (5).",
      "readings": [
        "Use a consistent projected inequality augmented Lagrangian with nonnegative multiplier updates.",
        "Use positive-part penalties max(g_i,0)^2 and update nonnegative multipliers only for violated constraints.",
        "Follow the listed unconditional merit function and unprojected signed multiplier updates literally."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "line-search exit after an accepted trial",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Algorithm 2 lines 11–22 contain an unconditional while loop, but no break or return after accepting a trial; a finite line-search exit must be supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "Exit immediately after the first trial satisfying L'<=L, promoting the accepted trial state.",
        "Continue accepted steps along the current direction until max|Delta x|<=10^-3, then return to recompute the direction."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "consistent compliance and sensitivity normalization",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 defines f=0.5 u^T K u, but Eq. (5) uses the sensitivity -u^T(dK/dx)u, corresponding to full compliance rather than that half-compliance objective.",
      "readings": [
        "Use f=0.5 u^T K u with sensitivity -0.5 u^T(dK/dx)u.",
        "Use f=u^T K u with sensitivity -u^T(dK/dx)u."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    }
  ]
}
